# Herbert AI

> Herbert AI builds custom software and AI for small businesses. It is based in Adelaide, South Australia, and was founded by Will Herbert. Every engagement starts with a free AI audit, and the first build is one AI employee for one job, live in 14 days for $3,500 fixed.

Herbert AI works with owner-operated businesses of roughly 3 to 20 staff, in five industries: health (allied health clinics), property (property managers and real estate agencies), trades (trades businesses with an office), hospitality (venues, restaurants and cafes) and finance (accountants and bookkeepers). It is based in Adelaide and works with businesses across Australia. Clients are not named publicly.

## What it sells

Herbert AI sells one ladder, taken in order.

1. A free AI audit: 45 minutes on how the business runs, then a written page within two business days that puts a yearly cost on each repetitive job, in the business's own figures, and names the one to hand over first.
2. Your first AI employee: one AI employee for one job, $3,500 fixed, live on the business's real data in 14 days or it is free. The first 30 days of hosting and support are included, then $200 a month care, a handover to the business's own accounts, or a bigger build. The $3,500 is credited in full to a bigger build started within 60 days.
3. An AI operating system: the full build, from $25,000, scoped after the audit and quoted as one fixed number. Files, communications and follow-ups run on one system, and the business owns it.
4. A retainer from $1,000 a month, month to month, with a monthly report.

If the audit shows the saving would not comfortably cover the price, the business is told so.

## What an AI employee is

An AI employee is software that does one job in the office, end to end, on the business's real systems, with a person approving anything that goes out to a customer. Each one carries a first name and its job, say "Emma · Maintenance" for a property manager's maintenance requests or "Gus · Recoveries", which compares every signed agreement with what was actually charged. The business names its own AI employee when the build starts. It is not sold as a replacement for staff.

Examples by industry:
- Property: a maintenance coordinator that logs a tenant's request, books a tradie inside the landlord's limit and keeps everyone told.
- Finance: a document chaser that chases clients for their documents at tax time and files them into the practice software.
- Health: a front desk assistant for intake forms, referral letters, recalls and no-show follow-ups.
- Trades: a quote follow-up that chases every quote that went out and never heard back.
- Hospitality: replies to function and event enquiries drafted for a person to approve, site visits booked, proposals sent and deposits chased.

## Herbert OS

The AI operating system for each industry is named Herbert OS, with the industry after it: Herbert OS for Property, Herbert OS for Trades, Herbert OS for Health, Herbert OS for Hospitality and Herbert OS for Finance. It puts the whole office on one screen: what the AI employees handled overnight, what is waiting on a person, and what each job is worth. For an example property agency of ten staff with 400 rentals, the site estimates about 17 to 37 hours of office work a week handed to AI employees.

## Herbert Reach (in development)

Herbert Reach is a product by Herbert AI, in development: a marketing department for local service businesses. The owner types the business name, and Herbert Reach writes ads, runs ads, answers leads and books jobs, with every channel judged by its cost per booked job.

## Common questions

- How much does an AI employee cost? Herbert AI's first AI employee is $3,500 fixed, live in 14 days or free, with the first 30 days of hosting and support included.
- How much does a full AI system cost? From $25,000, quoted as one fixed number after the free audit.
- Is the audit really free? Yes. It is 45 minutes plus a written page within two business days, and the business keeps the page whether or not it goes ahead.
- Who owns what gets built? The business does. Builds run on the business's own accounts.
- Does it replace staff? No. Each AI employee does one job, and a person on the team approves what goes out.
- Where is Herbert AI? Adelaide, South Australia. It works with businesses across Australia.
